name: New Hampshire
estimates: Presidential returns are from the tonmcg/US_County_Level_Election_Results_08-24 compilation (scraped from media result pages: Townhall 2016, Fox/Politico/NYT 2020, Fox 2024). They are close to but not the certified canvass; 2016 in particular is an election-week count and undercounts late-tallied ballots. "other" = total - dem - rep.
New England towns are county subdivisions, not Census "places", so places[] holds only the incorporated cities/boroughs/villages and covers a minority of the population.
For places spanning several counties, "county" is the county containing the Gazetteer internal point. Place pop for consolidated city-counties is the "(balance)" figure where Census publishes one.

house: 55 members sit for floterial districts, which overlay several base districts and have no Census shape. Each was seated on the base district of the same county that held the fewest seats — the person and party are real, the exact district placement is an approximation.

house: 18 seat(s) have inc null (vacant in OpenStates or unmatched); they were placed on the district shapes holding the fewest seats, which for multi-member chambers is an approximation of where the vacancy really is.
house: 400 seats over 164 district shapes (multi-member districts); seats per district follow the number of OpenStates legislators matched to each shape. Multi-member seat ids are "<district>/<n>".

District shapes are Census 2025 cartographic boundary files (SLDL/SLDU, 1:500k), i.e. the districts Census held as of that vintage; inc is the office-holder in the OpenStates "current" export on the build date, name and party only. District lat/lon is the centroid of the largest polygon of the simplified shape.

Demographics: ACS 2020-2024 5-year estimates (sample survey, subject to margin of error). white/black/asian are non-Hispanic single-race shares; hisp is Hispanic of any race. Income is top-coded by Census at 250,001.

Geometry simplified with mapshaper (interval 91 m, topology-preserving per layer; tiny islands dropped), coordinates rounded to 4 decimals. County, house and senate layers are simplified separately, so their borders can differ by up to the tolerance.
